subject: Post-call: Next steps & stakeholder map (Novasys) - MAP draft attached
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Stone <alex.stone@novasys.com>, Erin Hale <erin.hale@novasys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference>

Subject: Post-call: Next steps & stakeholder map (Novasys) - MAP draft attached

Hi Alex / Erin —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it’s fresh: 

Call highlights
- Primary business driver: accelerate patient triage automation across 120 clinics (cost + speed).
- Economic buyer: Alex (you) confirmed exec sponsorship from VP Clinical Ops, Jason Lee (CC suggested).
- Security/compliance asks: SOC 2 status, data residency in US-EAST, logging retention (1 year), and vendor risk questionnaire.
- Procurement: Novasys procurement prefers a 60–75 day review window for new vendors.

Attachments I’m sharing
- Novasys_MAP_v1.xlsx (prelim mutual action plan - milestone + owners)
- SLA-term-sheet.pdf (starter SLA and T&Cs we typically use)

Proposed MAP (high level) — please review and flag owners
1) Technical deep dive (security + infra alignment) — target: 2027-09-23 — owner: Novasys engineering (Erin) + Redwood tech (Rishi)
2) Procurement review (commercial + legal) — target: 2027-10-07 — owner: Novasys procurement + Redwood sales ops (Marissa)
3) SOC2 evidence & pen-test summary exchange — target: 2027-09-30 — owner: Redwood (Rishi)
4) Pilot kickoff (PO/contract sign) — target: 2027-10-21 — owner: Novasys PM + Redwood CSM

Can you confirm: (a) the right economic buyer(s) in copy, (b) procurement contact and their preferred cadence, and (c) whether the timeline above looks aggressive / OK?

If that’s good, I’ll push an updated MAP to the shared drive and schedule the technical deep dive.

Thanks —

Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0197

Subject: Re: Post-call: Next steps & stakeholder map (Novasys) - MAP draft attached

Logan — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Procurement lead: Maya Singh (m.singh@novasys.com). She prefers weekly status emails and one consolidated packet for the 1st review.
2) Security: I’ll loop in our CISO, Erin (CC’d), for the technical deep dive. The key items they asked for today were SOC 2 report, encryption-at-rest details, and a sample logging/access audit.
3) Timeline: the MAP looks reasonable, though procurement may push the procurement review target out by one week depending on workload.

We’ll take a look at the MAP and SLA and get a short list of redlines back. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports regional data partitioning in us-east? That’s a gating question for our security team.

I’ll send contact details for procurement (Maya) and legal (legal@novasys.com) in a follow-up.

—Alex
Alex Stone
Director, Clinical Operations | Novasys Health
alex.stone@novasys.com
